From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@brightgrid.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: security@brightgrid.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightGrid Vendr onboarding - data residency and presign evidence

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking this. We are starting our vendor security intake for Redwood as part of BrightGrid's procurement checklist. Two items we need clarified before we move to the legal review: 

1) Data residency: we require confirmation that any customer data uploaded via the Vendr portal (S3-staging) is stored only in US regions. Can you provide the SOC 2 / infrastructure attestations that specify region guarantees or how Redwood enforces region lock?

2) Pre-signed S3 evidence: our internal control requires that pre-signed URLs used for evidence upload have a TTL <= 1 hour and that objects are retained for a minimum of 90 days in a customer-controlled bucket. Can you confirm Redwood's presign TTL defaults and whether we can request enforcement to us-east-1 only?

If possible, please attach the SOC2 summary and any mapping to the CAIQ controls. I attached a template CAIQ mapping we prefer in the first pass.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Senior Security Program Manager
BrightGrid
attachments: SOC2-Type2-summary.pdf, caiaq-mapping.csv

Jordan — quick update: we have the SOC 2 Type II summary that explicitly lists control environments and the geographic regions used for hosted artifacts. I will extract the signed summary (redact PCI details) and upload to the Vendr portal under the "Evidence -> Redwood Inference (customer-facing)" section.

Regarding presigned uploads: our current presign service issues URLs scoped to the tenant's configured bucket. By default, tenants are in us-east-1 for new customers; we can request to pin uploads to us-east-1 but that requires a short ops change and a config flag at provisioning time. The default TTL for pre-signed URLs is 2 hours on our ingestion pipeline, but we have a documented endpoint to set TTLs per-upload — we rarely set it lower at scale.

Proposed reply items for BrightGrid:
- Attach SOC2-Type2-summary.pdf (redacted) and CAIQ mapping CSV (we'll populate).
- Confirm that we can request presign TTL <= 1 hour (ops approval required).
- Offer a 90-day retention recommendation and a note that customers may use their own bucket (customer-controlled), in which case Redwood does not retain the object beyond processing time (we provide a signed proof-of-possession manifest).

I'll upload the evidence to Vendr and post the link; will also include a short ops-runbook for setting region pinning. ETA: noon tomorrow.

Irene Choi
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
